Bini Sunil vs Corporation Of Kochi on 9 February, 2024 
Author: Murali Purushothaman Bench: Murali Purushothaman  IN THE HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE MURALI PURUSHOTHAMAN  FRIDAY, THE 9TH DAY OF FEBRUARY 2024 / 20TH MAGHA, 1945  WP(C) NO. 5056 OF 2024 PETITIONER:
 BINI SUNIL  AGED 45 YEARS  W/O. SUNIL THOMAS, CHANDRANKUNNEL HOUSE,
 ANRA 22, AISWARYA NAGAR,
 CHOORAKKAD, THRIPUNITHURA,
 ERNAKULAM, KOCHI,
 PIN - 682 301. 
 BY ADV PRAMOD KOCHUTHOMMEN EELIAS RESPONDENTS: 
 1 CORPORATION OF KOCHI  PARK AVENUE, ERNAKULAM HEAD POST OFFICE P.O.,
 ERNAKULAM DISTRICT,
 REPRESENTED BY ITS SECRETARY,
 PIN - 682 011.
 2 SECRETARY  CORPORATION OF KOCHI, PARK AVENUE,
 ERNAKULAM HEAD POST OFFICE P.O.,
 ERNAKULAM DISTRICT, PIN - 682 011. 
 3 THE HEALTH INSPECTOR  CIRCLE NO.17, CORPORATION OF KOCHI,
 PARK AVENUE, ERNAKULAM HEAD POST OFFICE P.O.,
 ERNAKULAM DISTRICT, PIN - 682 011.
 4 DILIP KUMAR T.P  S/O. PARAMESWARAN T.K.,
 ASHIQ BHAVANAM, VILLA NO.15  VINAYAKA PALACE, NADAMA VILLAGE,
 KANAYANNUR TALUK, ERNAKULAM DISTRICT,
 KOCHI, PIN - 682 306. 
 SRI. R.HARISHANKAR - SC  SMT. DEVISHRI - GP Bini Sunil vs Corporation Of Kochi on 9 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177758683/ 
1  THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 09.02.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 WP(C).No.5056 OF 2024  2  JUDGMENT The petitioner is the tenant in the building bearing No.50/174-E, F of Kochi Corporation. The petitioner is running a restaurant in the said building. The petitioner has been issued with Ext.P8 notice by the 3rd respondent stating that the petitioner is running the business without IFTE and OS licence. The petitioner states that he has submitted Ext.P9 reply to Ext.P8 notice. However,
without considering the same, the Corporation is proceeding against the petitioner. Accordingly, the petitioner has filed this writ petition. The limited prayer of the petitioner is for a consideration of Ext.P9 filed in reply to Ext.P8.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel for respondents 1 to 3. In the nature of the directions I propose to issue, notice to the 4th respondent is dispensed with. 
3. In the facts and circumstances of the case WP(C).No.5056 OF 2024 and having regard to the submissions made across the Bar, there will be a direction to the 2 nd respondent to consider the reply of the petitioner to Ext.P8 and pass appropriate orders thereon, after hearing the petitioner and the 4th respondent and in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, at any rate, within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment. Till such time, there shall not be any coercive proceedings against the petitioner pursuant to Ext.P8. 
The writ petition is disposed of with the above direction.
Sd/-
MURALI PURUSHOTHAMAN JUDGE SPR WP(C).No.5056 OF 2024 APPENDIX PETITIONER'S EXHIBITS:-
EXHIBIT P1 TRUE COPY OF THE LICENSE NO.536/C-13/ 2022-2023 DATED 11-8-2022 ISSUED IN FAVOUR OF PETITIONER BY FIRST RESPONDENT.
EXHIBIT P2 TRUE COPY OF THE LEASE AGREEMENT DATED 06.06.2022 ENTERED BETWEEN THE PETITIONER AND THE 4TH RESPONDENT. 
EXHIBIT P3 TRUE COPY OF THE RECEIPT DATED 23.2.2023 WITH REGARD TO THE PAYMENT OF BUILDING TAX TO THE 1ST RESPONDENT BY THE 4TH RESPONDENT.

2 EXHIBIT P4 TRUE COPY OF THE RECEIPT DATED 23.2.2023 WITH REGARD TO THE PAYMENT OF BUILDING TAX TO THE 1ST RESPONDENT BY THE 4TH RESPONDENT. 
EXHIBIT P5 TRUE COPY OF THE APPLICATION FOR RENEWAL OF LICENSE BY THE PETITIONER TO THE 1ST RESPONDENT DATED 11.03.2023. 
EXHIBIT P6 TRUE COPY OF THE ACKNOWLEDGEMENT RECEIPT DATED 11.03.2023 ISSUED BY THE 1ST RESPONDENT.
